notice: SYNTHETIC RECORDS. Made up by radar/declarations/generate.py from a seed, to show what the radar's restricted layer would do with export declarations. No record is or describes a real declaration, exporter, consignee, forwarder or agent; the ids are made up and look nothing like EORI numbers; there are no names, addresses or postcodes.
house_line: A rise in exports is a lead, not evidence of a breach.
about_format: Columns of equal length, one value per goods item, in order of acceptance date. To rebuild record i: constants hold the fields that are the same on every record; a dict column's value is an index into dictionaries[column]; an int column's value is the value; net_mass_kg is in tenths of a kilogram; supplementary_units holds the count or null; acceptance_date holds the days since the previous record (the first counts from base_date); declaration_ref counts up by one at every record whose goods_item is 1, written as prefix plus a six-digit number; routing is an index into dictionaries.routing; description is descriptions[commodity_code]; documents holds 0 for none or [code index, reference number, status index] into documents.codes and documents.statuses, the reference written as SYN-DOC- plus six digits.
